categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Adds shared assertion macros in `src/test/util/common.h` for use across unit and fuzz tests, bearing the Tests label.
categories.rationale: Improves unit test infrastructure by introducing thread-safe, fail-fast assertion macros reusable in fuzz tests and catching signedness mismatches at compile time. Boost test macros currently lack thread safety under TSAN and obscure errors with cascaded failures in CI, but replacing them is standard modernization rather than fixing an urgent CI failure.
